intro: Before any rule: each letter from its place (المخرج) with its qualities (الصفات).
Look at the letter after the نْ or the تنوين. That letter decides which of the four rules applies.
Look at the letter after the مْ. There are three outcomes.
A sound from the nose (الخيشوم), held for two counts on every نّ and مّ.
Two questions: is it the ل of ال, or the ل in the name اللَّه?
Look at the ر's own vowel first. If it has سكون, look at the letter before it.
Five letters bounce when they carry سكون: قطب جد.
Every مد starts at 2 counts. A همزة or a سكون after it makes it longer.
When two letters meet and the first has سكون, they may merge into one.
Where to stop, how to stop, and how to start again.
A few words in رواية حفص have their own way of reading.
